items.title: Chalmers pushes ambitious budget as Middle East war fuels inflation
items.description: The treasurer will outline how the May federal budget will respond to the crisis with a focus on "substantial" savings, productivity and tax changes to make the system fairer for younger Australians.

items.title: Trump promised a 'wild' meeting with Xi, but surely he didn't mean this
items.description: The US president said last month that his planned visit to China on March 31 would be "a wild one". A lot has changed since that confident declaration and most of it has weakened his position.

items.title: Australian facilities damaged in Iranian attack on Middle East air base
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has revealed that an Iranian projectile hit a road just outside the Al Minhad Air Base, but no Australians were injured.

items.title: Iran confirms intelligence minister killed in Israeli strike, 12 dead in Beirut attack
items.description: Israel's defence minister, Israel Katz, says Iran's intelligence minister, Esmail Khatib, has been killed in air strikes overnight, but there has been no confirmation from Tehran of his reported death.

items.title: Iranian women's football team back in Iran, state media announces
items.description: The delegation of players and staff included five people who initially accepted Australia's offer of asylum but later changed their minds.

items.title: Urgent call to ensure all babies are born a healthy weight
items.description: The Productivity Commission’s latest Closing the Gap data shows just four out of 19 targets are on track. Advocates call for urgent funding to address low birth weights.

items.title: Record property profits see home owner wealth surge despite rising rates
items.description: Australian home owners now have the protection of a "financial shield" in uncertain times, a report by property portal Domain has found, but record profits from property resales are widening the gap between established owners and aspiring first home buyers.

items.title: Tougher tobacco laws on the way as illegal vape market booms
items.description: Criminal gangs cashing in on Australia's illicit tobacco boom will face tougher penalties and expanded police surveillance powers in a fresh crackdown on the black market.

items.title: 'Absolute disaster': Media analysts weigh in on Sandilands sacking
items.description: Shock jock Kyle Sandilands was likely sacked because of pressure from the media regulator and his huge $100 million contract, former ABC Media Watch host Paul Barry says.

items.title: Hanson in confrontations with SA premier and MP as poll support continues
items.description: South Australia's premier tells Pauline Hanson he will work with any One Nation MPs elected on Saturday, as a new poll shows the right-wing party remains ahead of the Liberals.

items.title: Military officers arrested over acid attack on Indonesian activist
items.description: Four Indonesian officers have been arrested and detained over an acid attack on human rights campaigner Andrie Yunus in Jakarta.

items.title: Severe Cyclone Narelle upgraded to category three system
items.description: Tropical Cyclone Narelle could threaten Queensland coast as a severe category five system this week.

items.title: Australia's fuel shipments look safe for the next month. After that, it's complicated
items.description: Ships carrying oil are continuing to come to Australia as expected and should do so for the next month, and the industry is urging that while the picture beyond that is uncertain and complicated, "the tankers have never stopped coming".

items.title: Daly River evacuee's heartbreak at seeing flooded community
items.description: Flood evacuees from Daly River in the remote Northern Territory — who have now spent more than a month this year in evacuation centres — say many had lost "everything they worked for".

items.title: Possum found in Hobart Airport gift shop soft toy section
items.description: A real possum nestled among toys and animals in a gift shop has thrilled passengers — but caused "pandemonium" after going on a sightseeing tour of the departure lounge.

items.title: Which hand soap is best for killing germs?
items.description: Experts say there is an array of options when it comes to hand soaps, and some labels can be misleading.

items.title: Abusive mailbox flyers leave LGBTQIA+ community members reeling
items.description: Police are investigating flyers dropped in mailboxes across Perth targeting members of the LGBTQIA+ community.

items.title: Chronic conditions dismissed as anxiety, low iron
items.description: Young women have detailed their experiences being dismissed and misdiagnosed as chronic pain sufferers. Now, they're teaching others how to advocate for their health.

items.title: Japan storm into Asian Cup final against Matildas with ominous dismantling of South Korea
items.description: Japan has produced a frighteningly good display to overpower South Korea 4-1, and book a spot in the Women's Asian Cup final against the Matildas.

items.title: 'You have to laugh': Why this critique of corporate work culture is a comedy
items.description: This dark comedy takes aim at capitalism and corporate work culture, but it also finds hope in the relationships between everyday people.

items.title: How a new steel mill plans to support economy, climate, and Olympics
items.description: The developer claims its production technology can reduce carbon emissions by more than 70 per cent compared with the conventional steel-making process.

items.title: Man faces court charged with rape and murder of 62yo woman in brothel
items.description: A forensic pathologist has told a committal hearing for Michael James Chalmers she believed the 62-year-old woman died from neck compression, smothering or gagging.

items.title: Cross River Rail boss tells inquiry CFMEU 'purposefully' caused disruptions
items.description: Cross River Rail Delivery Authority chief executive Graeme Newton told an inquiry into the CFMEU the union had "consistently made unsubstantiated claims" on social media and through media organisations about poor worksite safety.

items.title: 'Moment of pride': Venezuela edges US to win first World Baseball Classic
items.description: Venezuela claims its first World Baseball Classic championship with a 3-2 win over the United States in Miami.

items.title: 'Special human' James Slipper to break Super Rugby record
items.description: The prop will have played more Super Rugby than anyone else and is hoping to continue next season.
